description: Known-chronic failure signatures for the scheduled 'Verification 1.0 Release Proof' workflow. A red run whose failure signatures are all listed here is chronic red carrying no new information; any signature NOT listed here is a NEW failure that must be triaged. The signature tripwire (verify:ci:signature-tripwire) diffs fresh run artifacts against this ledger. Update deliberately — every entry needs a classification and a disposition, never a bare suppression.

baseline.note: Reconciled 2026-08-16 against post-merge dispatch 31982472019: agentic-proof and agentic-governance (linux_firejail_missing) cleared by PR #249's resolveSandboxMetadata stub and were removed from this ledger; architecture-metrics appeared as a new ratchet failure and is re-armed in the same PR as this reconciliation.

signatures.detail: PRs #249/#250 legitimately grew guarded metrics (GatewayService 13103→13129 lines; chat-turn-capability-profile-service typed dependency accesses 16→18 from the interposition seam) against a stale baseline.
signatures.disposition: Baseline regenerated via architecture:baseline:update in the same PR as this ledger. Remove after the next scheduled run confirms green; the underlying GatewayService decomposition debt remains tracked separately.

signatures.match: expected visible realtime replay recovery or polling fallback copy
signatures.detail: Realtime pill copy moved into the collapsed System <details> popover of the status strip; body innerText omits it until the popover opens.
signatures.disposition: Fixed: scenario now opens the System popover before asserting (this PR); lane proven green locally against the real stack. Remove after the next scheduled run confirms.

signatures.detail: Same popover containment; additionally the degraded pill aria-label gained an ' (unavailable)' suffix the exact-match selector could never match.
signatures.disposition: Fixed: popover open + prefix selector (this PR). Remove after confirmation.

signatures.detail: install.gateway.bootstrap asserts OS-keychain custody, but the verification stack itself runs with GOATCITADEL_DISABLE_SECRET_STORE=true, so SECRET_STORE_UNAVAILABLE reproduces on every harness host (confirmed locally on Windows, not only ubuntu runners) — the lane contradicts its own environment.
signatures.disposition: Held — owner decision needed: run the install smoke with the secret store enabled (real keychain on desktop, headless keyring on CI), or make the bootstrap check assert the explicit degraded posture when the store is disabled.

signatures.match: The capability candidate has no linked Code Mode proposal
signatures.detail: The scenario promoted a staged candidate directly, but review-first evolution governance requires a linked proposal and a driven Change Plan. Driving the real flow also exposed a product defect: the adapter gated activate-plan drafting on candidate.activationBlocked, which is true for every never-promoted candidate, making first-time activation impossible (its unit fixture hand-set activationBlocked:false, concealing this).
signatures.disposition: Fixed (this PR): the scenario creates the linked proposal and drives the Change Plan (artifact review → confirmation → approval), and the adapter now gates on the selected version not being revoked. Scenario passes locally. Remove after the next scheduled run confirms.

signatures.match: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 400
signatures.detail: Onboarding auto-selects the zero-cost local provider and fetches its models; the local-runtime lease failure ('llama.cpp runtime is disabled in assistant config') escaped the discovery fallback and surfaced as a console 400.
signatures.disposition: Fixed: lease acquisition moved inside the discovery try so lease failures degrade to error_fallback with a warning (this PR). Remove after confirmation.

signatures.detail: Cross-platform visual margins vs fresh Linux baselines (intentional M7 drift); baselines must be regenerated on Linux.
signatures.disposition: Run the visual-rebaseline workflow on a pushed branch and cherry-pick its chore commit; do not rebaseline locally on Windows. Reconcile the exact diff set against the post-merge run.
